About Us

From Sialkot's workshops to stadiums around the world

Sialkot makes more of the world's hand-stitched soccer balls than any other city — and our factory has been part of that craft since 2009. What started as a small stitching unit is today a complete export facility serving clubs, academies, wholesalers and sports brands in more than 30 countries.

Because everything is made under one roof, you get factory-direct prices, honest timelines and one team that answers for your whole order — from sample to shipment.

  • In-house stitching, printing and packing — no middlemen
  • Photo & video updates of your order at every stage
  • Export documentation handled for you, start to finish

Why Choose Us

Why buyers stay with us, order after order

Four simple commitments that make importing from Pakistan easy — even if it's your first order.

Quality Checked, Piece by Piece

Every ball is inflated and inspected, every kit is measured and checked before packing. You receive a QC report with photos before dispatch.

Your Brand, On Every Product

Custom logos, colours, printing and retail packaging — your products arrive ready to sell under your own brand name.

Low MOQs, Honest Prices

Start from just 50–100 pieces per design. Factory-direct pricing with a clear written quotation — no hidden charges, ever.

Delivered To Your Door

Worldwide shipping by air and sea, with delivery-to-door (DDP) options — we handle export paperwork and keep you updated until arrival.
